environment: Real iPhone 17 / iOS 26.6.1 (23G83), signed Debug app, real extension, synthetic Safari textarea
method: Original provider timeline plus matching PCM at speed 1; guarded directed native Space, space-pan cursor movement and q marker while cleanup remained active. On-device monotonic intent/snapshot, sent and queue confirmation events; independent native full-field readback. Scripted integration, not independent UAT.

nativeReadback.explicitAddedCharacters: q then a later native l

limits: Queue confirmation uses bounded proxy reports which can be optimistic. Independent native settled text confirms retained content/caret, not per-character display latency.
Timing excludes bridge/network transfer and chosen gesture hold; it starts at admitted snapshot or native key/cursor intent.
The longest observed response is 455.377 ms in this sample, not a universal or worst-case guarantee.
The later native l is recorded separately without actor attribution and must be preserved.
The original c355a35 failure remains in speech-tail-failure-summary.json for comparison.
